svg.title: Toolbox — Prem Sai Kota
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Rust. Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion. Backend & Data: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Supabase, MongoDB, Redis. Real-time: Yjs CRDTs, WebSockets, Socket.io, Server-Sent Events. AI & Retrieval: Gemini, Ollama, ChromaDB, BM25 hybrid search, MCP. Desktop & Infra: Tauri, Electron, Docker, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Cloudflare Workers.
